import sys, json, random, collections
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor')
import gen, controller
cnt=collections.Counter(); tot=0
for seed in range(200,320):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    case=gen.make_case(rng)
    raw=json.dumps({'version':3,'cases':[case]}).encode()
    out=controller.run(raw)
    r=out['results'][0]
    cnt[tuple(r['ratio'])]+=1
    tot+=sum(1 for x in r['assignment'] if x>=0)
print('coverage distribution:', sorted(cnt.items(), key=lambda kv:-kv[1])[:15])
print('distinct ratios', len(cnt), 'assigned total', tot)
PYEOF
